title: cucumis pepo
intro: Cucumis pepo, commonly known as the zucchini or summer squash, is a type of vining plant belonging to the Cucurbitaceae family. This plant is rich in nutrients and offers several health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and providing antioxidants that can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Cucumis pepo include its anti-diabetic, anti-obesity, and anti-cancer properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as cucurbitacins, flavonoids, and carotenoids. The bioactive constituents of Cucumis pepo also exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, contributing to its potential health benefits and therapeutic uses.
